    banks = load_dir(RAW)["ground_truth"]["parameters"]["phrase_banks"]
    entries = [e for b in banks["stance"].values() for e in b] + [e for b in banks["labels"].values() for e in b] + banks["neutral"]

@pytest.mark.req("ANL-03")
def test_score_computes_known_metrics():
    """On a hand-checked toy case, score() gives the expected precision, recall, F1, stance confusion matrix
    and macro-F1."""
    import pandas as pd
    t = {"a": {"stance": 1, "mentions_integrity": True, "mentions_collaboration": False, "mentions_careers": True},
         "b": {"stance": 0, "mentions_integrity": True, "mentions_collaboration": True, "mentions_careers": False},
         "c": {"stance": 1, "mentions_integrity": False, "mentions_collaboration": False, "mentions_careers": False}}
    coded = pd.DataFrame([{"stmt_id": "a", "stance": 1, "mentions_integrity": True, "mentions_collaboration": False, "mentions_careers": True},
                          {"stmt_id": "b", "stance": 1, "mentions_integrity": False, "mentions_collaboration": True, "mentions_careers": False},
                          {"stmt_id": "c", "stance": 1, "mentions_integrity": True, "mentions_collaboration": False, "mentions_careers": False}])
    s = coder_eval.score(t, coded)
    assert s["labels"]["mentions_integrity"] == pytest.approx({"precision": 0.5, "recall": 0.5, "f1": 0.5, "support": 2})
    assert s["labels"]["mentions_collaboration"]["f1"] == 1.0
    assert s["stance"]["confusion_matrix"]["rows_true_cols_coded"]["0"]["1"] == 1
    assert s["stance"]["accuracy"] == pytest.approx(2 / 3)
    # stance classes present: 0 (f1 0) and 1 (p 2/3, r 1, f1 0.8) -> macro 0.4
    assert s["stance"]["macro_f1"] == pytest.approx(0.4)
    assert s["macro_f1"] == pytest.approx((0.5 + 1.0 + 1.0 + 0.4) / 4)

def test_reserved_phrasings_appear_only_in_held_out_half(seed):
    """HUMAN: the dev/held-out split follows the public rule (odd inst_id number -> held-out). No dev
    statement contains any reserved phrasing (checked on the text itself), over half of held-out statements
    contain at least one, and at least 80% of reserved phrasings occur somewhere in the held-out half, so
    ANL-03's held-out score measures generalization rather than memorization."""
    mod = gen_module()
    _, rows = _labelled(seed)
    banks = list(mod.STANCE_SENTENCES.values()) + list(mod.LABEL_SENTENCES.values()) + [mod.NEUTRAL_SENTENCES]
    reserved = [e["text"] for b in banks for e in b if e["heldout"]]
    for s, lab, _ in rows:
        assert lab["split"] == ("heldout" if int(s["inst_id"][1:]) % 2 else "dev")
    dev = [s["text"] for s, lab, _ in rows if lab["split"] == "dev"]
    held = [s["text"] for s, lab, _ in rows if lab["split"] == "heldout"]
    assert dev and held
    assert not [t for t in dev if any(r in t for r in reserved)]
    assert sum(any(r in t for r in reserved) for t in held) > 0.5 * len(held)
    seen = sum(any(r in t for t in held) for r in reserved)
    assert seen >= 0.8 * len(reserved)

@pytest.mark.req("INST-07")
@pytest.mark.kind("integration")
def test_phase_from_first_req_prefix_and_kind_default(runfile):
    """phase comes from the first req ID's area (DATA -> P1, INST -> P0, TOK -> P6),
    not from .phase. With no req, phase is "untagged". kind defaults to unit."""
    data, tests = runfile
    assert (tests["test_pass"]["req_ids"], tests["test_pass"]["phase"]) == (["DATA-03"], "P1")
    assert (tests["test_fail"]["req_ids"], tests["test_fail"]["phase"]) == (["INST-01", "VAL-02"], "P0")
    assert tests["test_skip"]["phase"] == "P6"
    assert (tests["test_untagged"]["req_ids"], tests["test_untagged"]["phase"]) == ([], "untagged")
    assert tests["test_pass"]["kind"] == "property"
    assert tests["test_fail"]["kind"] == "unit"
    assert data["current_phase"] == "untagged"  # no .phase in the pytester project

@pytest.mark.req("INST-01")
@pytest.mark.kind("integration")
@pytest.mark.parametrize("event", EVENTS)
def test_registered_command_runs_from_path_with_spaces(tmp_path, event):
    """The exact command string from settings.json, run through a shell from a project dir
    whose path contains spaces (like the real one), reaches the hook and logs the event."""
    project = tmp_path / "proj with spaces"
    (project / ".claude" / "hooks").mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copy(HOOK, project / ".claude" / "hooks" / "log_event.py")
    cmd = _commands(event)[0]["command"]
    env = {**os.environ, "CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR": str(project)}
    stdin = json.dumps({"hook_event_name": event, "session_id": "s", "transcript_path": "",
                        "last_assistant_message": "x"})
    proc = subprocess.run(["/bin/sh", "-c", cmd], input=stdin, text=True,
                          capture_output=True, env=env, timeout=30)
    assert proc.returncode == 0 and proc.stdout == ""
    assert [e["event"] for e in events(project)] == [event]
